messages.subject: Problem with DWLS estimator/ordinal data
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to fit a model containing solely ordered predictors. The predictors are originally from a Likert scale with 7 items, and I know some may say I could treat them as continuous, but I am very cautious since the data are not even close to normal distributed. 
When I fit my model in Lavaan, it chooses automatically the DWLS estimator, which I assume is a good thing. However the process returns the following error:

Error in computeObjective(object, GLIST = GLIST, samplestats = samplestats,  : 
  this estimator: `DWLS' can not be used with incomplete data and the missing="ml" option

The data I feed into the model is complete. What are my options? What causes the error? Any ideas?

Thanks for your help

Regards
Roman

PS: The model is rather large with DF at around 850 and only 250 observations. Does this cause the problem?

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Problem with DWLS estimator/ordinal data
parts:
On 12/18/2013 10:12 AM, Roman wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I am trying to fit a model containing solely ordered predictors. The
> predictors are originally from a Likert scale with 7 items, and I know
> some may say I could treat them as continuous, but I am very cautious
> since the data are not even close to normal distributed.
> When I fit my model in Lavaan, it chooses automatically the DWLS
> estimator, which I assume is a good thing. However the process returns
> the following error:
>
> Error in computeObjective(object, GLIST = GLIST, samplestats =
> samplestats, :
>
> this estimator: `DWLS' can not be used with incomplete data
> and the missing="ml" option

Are you using mimic="Mplus"? This is an (unwanted) side-effect of this
(because mimic="Mplus" implies missing="ml"). The workaround is simply
to specify missing="listwise" explicitly.

BTW, this has been fixed in dev 0.5-16

Yves.
